# Go

Full rules, evidence and examples: `common/languages/go.md`.

- GO-01 must: Gate every repo on one `.golangci.yml` (v2 schema) through `make lint`, which runs `golangci-lint run -c .golangci.yml` then `go vet ./...`; `make fix` runs `golangci-lint fmt`. [tool:golangci-lint]
  Good: `make lint` runs `golangci-lint run -c .golangci.yml` then `go vet ./...`.
  Bad: a per-repo `make lint` that calls only `go vet ./...`.
- GO-02 must: Keep the strict profile and conform to it: complexity caps, `gochecknoglobals`, `gochecknoinits`, `nonamedreturns`, `mnd` (flags bare numbers except in the ignored functions the config lists, such as `time.Date`, `strconv.Parse*`, `os.WriteFile`, `flag.*`), `goconst`, `godot`, `testpackage`, `errorlint`, `errname`, `sloglint`, `depguard` (ban `log` outside main and `math/rand`), formatters `goimports`, `gofumpt`, `golines` at 120 columns. [tool:golangci-lint]
  Good: `var ErrNoHost = errors.New("no host")` and `const maxRetries = 3` instead of a bare `3`.
  Bad: `func load() (cfg Config, err error)` with a named return.
- GO-03 must: Go: write a suppression as `//nolint:<linter> // <reason>` with a short lowercase reason and no period (PRIN-44). [tool:golangci-lint]
  Good: `//nolint:gochecknoglobals // set at build time using ldflags`; a TODO line (PRIN-18) carries `//nolint:godox // TODO is required` because `godox` is on.
  Bad: `//nolint`
- GO-04 prefer: Use initialisms in identifiers (`ID`, `IP`, `URL`) and rename instead of suppressing when the linter is right. [tool:golangci-lint]
- GO-05 prefer: Allow package-level variables only for build-time values (`Version`, `Gitsha` via ldflags), module-level Pulumi config and default lists, each with a `nolint:gochecknoglobals` reason. [tool:golangci-lint]
- GO-06 prefer: Run Go tests with `go test -v -tags=all -parallel $(TESTPARALLELISM) -timeout 2h -covermode atomic -coverprofile=covprofile`; target names follow PRIN-45 and MAKE-01.
- GO-07 prefer: Stay on the latest Go minor within weeks of release; use `slices`, `maps`, `min` and range-over-int from the standard library. [tool:golangci-lint]
- GO-08 prefer: Lay out services as `cmd/<binary>`, `internal/` for private code and `pkg/` only for what other modules import; split `internal` by role (`configuration`, `logging`, `store`, `transport`, `health`).
- GO-09 prefer: Name files by action or noun (`create.go`, `validate.go`, `session.go`); use `constants.go` and `error.go` per package, and put `<file>_test.go` next to the file.
- GO-10 prefer: Constructors are `NewX(...)` returning the concrete pointer; interfaces are small, defined by the consumer and composed by embedding. [tool:golangci-lint]
- GO-11 prefer: Declare sentinel errors in a `var (...)` block in `error.go`, named `ErrX` (exported) or `errX`, and test with `errors.Is`. [tool:golangci-lint]
- GO-12 must: In new or substantially rewritten Go code in libraries (including pulumi/shared-library) and services, wrap errors with `%w` and add context; existing code stays unless touched. Pulumi programs log and return unchanged (PULUMI-02). [tool:golangci-lint]
  Good: `fmt.Errorf("failed to create the adguard client: %w", err)`
  Bad: `return err` with no context in a new library function.
- GO-13 lean: Example only, not a rule: vault validates a config struct by collecting all problems with the field path as prefix and returning them joined.
- GO-14 prefer: Services read configuration from environment variables through `caarlos0/env/v11` into one struct with `env` and `envDefault` tags; `Init()` exits on a parse error.
- GO-15 prefer: Document every config struct field with a doc comment that includes unit and default, written as GO-17 requires (starts with the identifier, ends with a period).
- GO-16 prefer: Use `log/slog` for new services; Pulumi programs keep zerolog (log prefixes: PULUMI-04). [tool:golangci-lint]
- GO-17 must: Give every exported function and type a one-line doc comment so callers know what it does from the rendered docs alone. Observed: start it with the identifier, end it with a period, and do the same for exported constants and fields. [tool:golangci-lint]
  Good: `// Create adds the record and returns its id.` above `func Create(...)`.
  Bad: `// adds the record` or no comment above an exported `Create`.
- GO-18 must: Under the summary line of an exported function, add one `name: description.` line for every parameter, even an obvious one such as `ctx`; this API documentation overrides PRIN-05 and PRIN-14. No `@param`, no headings.
  Good: `// ctx: The Pulumi context.` and `// timeout: Maximum wait in seconds, defaults to 30.`
  Bad: `// @param timeout the maximum wait`
- GO-19 prefer: In a doc comment, add behavior beyond the name only when not obvious: defaults, naming scheme, clamping, secrecy.
- GO-20 prefer: Inside functions, use short lowercase section labels in orchestration code (`// dns`, `// outputs`) or a reason for a constraint; never narrate the next line.
- GO-21 lean: Skip package comments.
- GO-22 prefer: Test in the external package (`package x_test`) with `testify` (`require` for preconditions, `assert` for values) and name tests `TestFunc` or `TestFunc_Variant`. [tool:golangci-lint]
- GO-23 prefer: Use table tests with `t.Run` for pure functions, one test per variant for resource creation, and `t.TempDir()` for files. [tool:golangci-lint]
- GO-24 prefer: Group imports as standard library, third party, local module, using goimports. [tool:golangci-lint]
- GO-25 lean: Document `main` as "main is the entry point of ..."; start, wait for SIGINT or SIGTERM, then shut down in reverse order.
- GO-26 must: Go: enforce PRIN-23 with `mnd`, and write file permissions in `0o` octal with a named default. [tool:golangci-lint]
  Good: `const defaultFileMode = 0o600` passed to `os.WriteFile(path, data, defaultFileMode)`.
  Bad: `os.WriteFile(path, data, 0600)`.
- GO-27 prefer: Keep lists and tuning constants per provider in a `defaults.go` with a one-line doc per item.
- GO-28 prefer: Quote values in error messages with `%q` and use `errors.New` for static text.
- GO-29 prefer: Pass slog keys as constants from a `logging` package and errors as `slog.Any("error", err)`; never use the global logger of the standard `log` package. [tool:golangci-lint]

Avoid (AI-Era Artifacts):

- Long prose doc comments on every private method and interface method (game-director, watermeter, 2026; lines are all owner-committed but the verbosity differs from 2023 code). Keep the one-line form (GO-17).
